title: Universal Program Invention Engine — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Searches for programs that satisfy a formal objective and evaluates them through execution and testing. A proposed engine that invents programs from objectives: given a formal objective, it searches program space for candidates that satisfy it, then evaluates each through actual execution and testing — keeping only programs proven to work, with the proof being the test run itself.
